query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE replayed_at IS NULL)::BIGINT AS "unresolved!", COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE replayed_at IS NOT NULL)::BIGINT AS "replayed!", COUNT(DISTINCT original_job_type) FILTER (WHERE replayed_at IS NULL)::BIGINT AS "distinct_unresolved_job_types!", MIN(failed_at) FILTER (WHERE replayed_at IS NULL) AS oldest_unresolved_failed_at, MAX(failed_at) FILTER (WHERE replayed_at IS NULL) AS newest_unresolved_failed_at FROM dead_letter_jobs
